subject: Space priming & keywork orchestration — initial access plan
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@luminahealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova, monica_patel
Cc: LuminaHealth Procurement <procurement@luminahealth.com>
Date: 2029-12-03T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Kickoff: initial access & API seeding

Hi Sofia / Monica,

Thanks for the kickoff this morning — great overview. To keep momentum, can you confirm the initial decisions we need from our side so we can make the credentialing and procurement steps smooth? Specifically: 

- Project namespace / recommended pattern for spaces and service accounts
- Which admin roles you recommend we seed (we have two SRE engineers + one product admin)
- Whether Redwood supports a KMS-backed HSM key for encrypting service keys (we use AWS KMS)
- A proposed timeline for API key seeding vs. SSO integration (we'd like API keys first so devs can start smoke testing)

I've attached our internal checklist for vendor onboarding (credentialing-checklist.pdf) and a CSV mapping of our current roles. Procurement is looped in for any contract or SOC evidence.

Appreciate a short plan with dates — Elena

--
Elena Morales
Head of Integrations, LuminaHealth
elena@luminahealth.com
+1 (415) 555-0127

From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@luminahealth.com>, monica_patel
Cc: ben_carter
Date: 2029-12-03T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: initial access & API seeding

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Proposed plan below (high level) so procurement & your SREs can align: 

1) Namespace & projects (Day 0 – Day 1)
- We create a top-level workspace: lumina-prod (can also create staging lumina-staging if you want parallel sandboxes)
- Recommended pattern: {company}-{env}-{project} (e.g., lumina-prod-search, lumina-staging-ingest)

2) Admin seeds & roles (Day 1)
- Seed two admin service accounts: lumina-admin-1, lumina-admin-2 (full admin for initial setup)
- Create roles: Workspace Admin, Billing Viewer, DevOps Key Manager, App Deployer. We'll share a role-matrix CSV (attached).

3) API key seeding (Day 1–2)
- We will provision scoped API keys for one sandbox project and one production project. Keys will be time-labeled and auditable.
- Ben Carter (cc'd) will perform the key seeding. He will provide the seed manifest and an HMAC-signed key bundle for you to ingest.

4) KMS/HSM & key encryption (Day 2)
- Redwood supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS for encrypting at rest. We do not require HSM hardware on your side for API keys; AWS KMS will meet encryption-in-transit/at-rest requirements.
- If you require HSM-backed KMS tenant isolation, we can open an engineering ticket and provide an ETA — please confirm.

5) SSO integration (Week 1)
- SSO (SAML/OIDC) can be added in parallel; however, we recommend API keys first for dev smoke tests. SSO is gated on SAML metadata and a short testing window.

Attachments: lumina-credentialing-checklist.pdf (you sent), role-matrix-v1.csv (we've adjusted with recommended names). Drive plan: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3c4D_lumina-onboard-plan

Proposed dates: API key seed on 2029-12-04, KMS confirmation by 2029-12-05, SSO test window starting 2029-12-09. If that works, Ben will follow up with the seed manifest and a secure transfer method.

Thanks —
Sofia
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com

Quick note from my side:
- Assigning Ben to own the API key seeds and the secure handoff. Ben: please produce seed_manifest.json and mark keys as 'initial' with one-week TTL if Lumina wants ephemeral start keys.
- We'll do a canary on lumina-staging-search first (two small requests at low concurrency) then flip to lumina-prod-search once smoke passes.
- If procurement needs SOC/Security evidence, I've attached the standard SOC2 extract and will follow up with the SOC report link.

Ben, can you confirm you can action the key seed tomorrow (2029-12-04) morning PST?

Thanks, Monica
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference.com

Thanks, Sofia & Monica — that looks good and aligns with our internal priorities. A few quick answers/requests: 

- Namespace pattern approved (we'll use lumina-prod-search, lumina-staging-ingest).
- We'll provide the two SRE emails and the product admin by EOD (you can seed those exact usernames).
- AWS KMS is acceptable; we don't need HSM at launch. Please include a note in the manifest that keys are KMS-wrapped.
- Procurement asked if keys can be delivered via an encrypted artifact (we prefer S3 presigned + KMS encryption). Is that supported?

We'll target the API key handoff on 2029-12-04 morning PST. Procurement contact is Ana Ruiz (ana.ruiz@luminahealth.com) — she may take over contract redlines.

Elena
